text: Iron is the working metal of the modern world. Nepal's Dhaubadi deposit in Nawalparasi is the basis of its first planned iron and steel plant. The chief ore is red haematite. Magnetite is the richest. Iron pyrite is never used for iron, because its sulphur makes the metal brittle when hot.
